method.data: Deterministic breadth-first four-child tree with Chinese text; all 100/1000/5000 nodes expanded, viewport clipping disabled, live minimap enabled.
method.initialization: createEditor completion includes first full render and two rAF paints; no additional ready wait is added.
method.operations: callMs is elapsed API invocation (awaiting its promise if async); feedbackMs additionally waits once for core stability and two rAF. Neither is CPU-only time.
method.drag: Actual Playwright mouse events invoke Drag plugin; adjacent end leaves at scale 1. 24 paced movement steps followed by controlled hover to satisfy upstream 300 ms overlap-check throttle. Parent change must verify.
method.panZoom: Actual mouse drag on blank canvas and Control+wheel events. RAF sampling covers active input; controlled drag hover is reported separately.
method.frames: achievedFps counts rAF callbacks per active wall second; intervalFps is reciprocal mean interval, not idle-inclusive whole-run FPS. Dropped-frame estimates assume 60 Hz.
method.memory: Chromium performance.memory JS heap samples; no forced GC, no claim of peak process/GPU memory.
method.export: Standard product JSON serialization and actual JSON parse/render roundtrip. Image correctness checked separately by 25-node core integration tests.

runs.clock: performance.now() milliseconds; ISO timestamps are UTC
